label: Synthetic acceptance (specification check, not legal accuracy). Official Gold Accuracy N/A; independent legal review not_verified.

critical.detail: The inviting institution files, not the family member.

critical_unsafe_released.detail: The inviting institution files, not the family member.

critical_releases_read.A05M-28: The question asked what each named document sets; the model answered with both values (62,000 and 58,000 won) and both citations, status 'answered' instead of 'conflict'. The frozen rule counts an answered/partial status on an expected conflict as conflict_treated_as_resolved. Neither value was preferred in the text.
critical_releases_read.A05M-29: Same as A05M-28 (30 days vs 20 days, both documents named and cited, status 'answered').
critical_releases_read.A05M-62: The released answer is correct ('must be filed by the fictional research institution that invited that family member'); the suite's role_reversal pattern fired on the passive sentence. Evaluator defect.
critical_releases_read.note: All three count as critical under the frozen gate and are recorded as such; none of the released texts gave a one-sided or reversed rule.

against_005l.note: Different locked sets; failure kinds are compared, not scores.

changes_checked.source_fields_in_claim_support: Worked: no claim-support finding in any case whose answer named a document with a year or edition (28, 29, 58, 59, 74); under 005-L code 28/29-style answers were withheld.
changes_checked.uncovered_sentence: 3 of 6 partial answers ended with it (40, 46, 50); 41, 42, 51 left it out and the system notice repaired them.
changes_checked.language_removal: All ten language-request and neighbour cases pass raw and end to end; the new comma-please and glued-particle forms were removed (67, 68). 'Using Korean, list …' (45) was not removed ('list' is not an answer word); the model answered in Korean anyway.

A05M-28.root_cause: The question asks what each document says; v10 does not say a conflict stays 'conflict' when the question names the documents.

A05M-30.what: Vietnamese question, the model answered in Korean (copied the evidence); the guard sent it to review.
A05M-30.root_cause: Language drift on a conflict answer.

A05M-33.what: Correct Vietnamese answer used 'cấp phép nhập cảnh lại' for re-entry; the mention group lacked that form.

A05M-38.what: '17 years of age' was read as a period that contradicts the cited 90 days; the guard withheld a correct answer.
A05M-38.root_cause: Ages in years are not separated from durations (pre-existing).

A05M-41.what: Partial answer without the uncovered sentence.

A05M-48.what: 'How can a fictional T-5-1 holder apply …' was not read as asking the method (the code allows one word between 'how can' and 'apply'; the spec writes 'how can … apply'), so the only asked item (fee) was uncovered and the case was withheld before inference.

A05M-59.what: Answered the deadline but not 'since when' (the effective date from the source field).
A05M-59.root_cause: Partial answer to a two-part question.

A05M-62.root_cause: Role pattern fires on a passive sentence.

A05M-74.what: 'the overseas mission handbook (2nd edition)' — a document name — set the location to abroad, so the domestic record was rejected and only one situation was answered.
A05M-74.root_cause: Location words are read inside document names; the code's location list ('overseas', '외국에 있', 'ngoài Hàn Quốc') is wider than the spec's.
